request.spec:
A person with a hold in force on the sheet's today (a hold whose dates include today) gets no cut
from any pool, and their share is spread over the other members with a cut in proportion to those
members' shares: each member's cut is the pot times their share divided by the shares of the members
with a cut, added up, rounded half to even, with the remainder to the largest share as before (when
no member is left with a cut, each shows 0.00). The pool's total share and balance are unchanged by
the hold.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A person with a hold in force on the sheet's today (a hold whose dates include today) gets no cut
from any pool, and their share is spread over the other members with a cut in proportion to those
members' shares: each member's cut is the pot times their share divided by the shares of the members
with a cut, added up, rounded half to even, with the remainder to the largest share as before (when

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Holds now pause pool cuts, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**The hold change** (front end only, since cuts were already worked out there):
- `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/pools/pools.ts`: a person member with a hold covering the sheet's today now gets 0.00 in every pool. The rest of the pot is split among the members who still get a cut, in proportion to their shares and rounded half to even. Any leftover hundredths go to the largest share among them, as before. If nobody is left with a cut, every member shows 0.00. A pool's total share and whether it balances don't change because of a hold.
- `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`: the cut total on each person's row uses the same rule, based on the sheet's today.

**A second fix the test needed:** one test failed for a reason unrelated to holds. It looks at the sheet as of an earlier date and expects to see a statement that was cancelled later. Cancelling a statement used to delete it, so that earlier view had lost it. Now:
- A new migration, `V72__statement_cancelled.sql`, adds a `cancelled_on` date to the statement table.
- Cancelling a statement marks it with that date instead of deleting it.
- The current view ignores cancelled statements. A view as of an earlier date still shows a statement if it was cancelled after that date.

This also means cancelled statements now stay in the database.
